turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Maya, an AI assistant calling from Northgate Lettings about the enquiry you made on our website. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes. How much is the actual deposit, not the holding one, the proper one?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The security deposit is five weeks' rent, because the annual rent on Elm Road is under fifty thousand pounds. At fourteen hundred a month that comes to about sixteen hundred and fifteen pounds.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay, and that's protected somewhere, I assume?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I don't have the details of the deposit scheme to hand, so I'd rather not guess. The team can confirm that at the viewing. Would you like to book one?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Friday at two is booked at Elm Road. You'll get a text with the address and the name of the staff member meeting you.
